---
name: Feature request
about: Suggest an improvement to the skin or the demo
title: "[Feature] "
labels: enhancement
---

**The problem or opportunity**
What can't you do today, or what would be better?

**Your proposal**
What you would like to see. Keep in mind the design discipline: matte archive surfaces, Signal Orange interaction colour, no glass/gradients/glow.

**Alternatives you considered**
Any other approaches, and why you set them aside.

**Impact on accessibility or compatibility**
Anything this would change for keyboard users, screen-reader users (note: screen-reader support is currently unverified — see docs/accessibility.md), or older browsers.
